headline: Cisco chief executive Chuck Robbins said efforts to slow AI will not work and the focus should be on stronger security and defences.
score_reason: Pool score kept: on-record view from a large network-equipment company's chief executive; opinion with no new action.
importance_line: The view is that of an executive whose company sells security and network gear, so it favours investment in defences, and it adds to an industry split between those who want to slow AI and those who say that is unrealistic.
summary: PTI reports, as carried by Rediff, that Chuck Robbins, chairman and chief executive of the network-equipment maker Cisco, said in an interview on Wednesday "You are not going to slow it down," and that security and defences must move "at the same pace or faster" than AI. He also said AI models are exposing gaps in basic cyber hygiene at customers, such as password and patch management, and that he does not see AI as a net job disruptor.
